card.line: The Valley of Elah is a valley in Judah where Israel camped to face the Philistines, the place where David killed the giant Goliath.

moments.title: Israel camps for battle
moments.text: Saul and the men of Israel gathered in the Valley of Elah to get ready to fight the Philistines. The two armies stood on hills with the valley between them.

moments.title: Goliath's challenge
moments.text: A champion named Goliath came out from the Philistine camp, wearing bronze armor and carrying a huge spear. He shouted for Israel to choose one man to come down and fight him.

moments.title: Goliath's sword remembered
moments.text: Later, the priest told David that Goliath's sword was kept there, wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. He spoke of Goliath as the Philistine David had killed in the Valley of Elah, and David took the sword.
